checkout.promise: Workout delivery · 30–60 min from when the restaurant accepts. Slow on purpose — a runner carries your food.

topup.title: Top up wallet

pin.waiting: Your PIN appears here once the restaurant accepts.

rate.sub_courier: How was the handover? Never blame the courier for the food.
rate.sub_restaurant: How was the food and packing? The courier is not responsible for this.
